name: agentarmy-arcadedb
description: Thin derived ArcadeDB image, correct-by-default: read-only MCP posture, platform_reader service user, knowledge database, and doctor-stub types baked in.

secrets.name: arcadedb_service_password
secrets.description: platform_reader read-only user; same value clients read via ARCADEDB_PASSWORD_FILE.

baked.purpose: Read-only MCP posture (all mutations false, scoped to platform_reader), re-applied every boot.
IF NOT EXISTS Chunk/StoredObject/IngestJob document types so the doctor passes.

doctor.description: Hits /api/v1/ready and queries the stub types as platform_reader; MCP posture is read-only and reachable.

deploy.notes: ACA deploy lane lives under deploy/ (bicep + deploy.yml); copy into the spoke to build/push (this repo ships no registry push pipeline).

contract.note: Vendor HTTP/JSON API; the AgentArmy-authored posture is the read-only MCP config (config/mcp-config.json).
Cockpit backend contract is extensions/arcadedb-cockpit/BACKEND_CONTRACT.md (markdown). Formalize as OpenAPI + register if the cockpit API stabilizes.
